# axm packs uninstall

Uninstall a pack

## When to use

Uninstall a pack

## Usage

```bash
axm packs uninstall [flags] <name>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description                                   |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `name` | string | Yes      | Name or glob pattern of the pack to uninstall |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                               |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Skip the 'are you sure?' confirmation                     |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Remove even if extensions in this pack are used elsewhere |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would be removed without making changes         |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Remove a pack and its orphaned extensions**

```bash
axm packs uninstall my-pack
```

**Check what would be removed first**

```bash
axm packs uninstall my-pack --preview
```

**Remove without confirmation (scripts/CI)**

```bash
axm packs uninstall my-pack --yes
```

**Remove all packs matching a pattern**

```bash
axm packs uninstall acme-*
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
